meta.name: completion-check
meta.description: Completion Check: Verify Infrastructure Is Wired

copy.tagline: 验证基础设施连接是否完整
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在部署前确认所有基础设施组件已正确连接
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm all infrastructure components are properly connected before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你声明基础设施完成前，自动检查代码是否真正接入系统并运行，避免出现死代码或未连接的组件。
howto.when: 当你完成基础设施开发并准备标记为“完成”时触发。

say.text: 检查我刚刚写的 Task 工具是否真的被调用了。
say.note: Claude 会追踪执行路径并验证调用关系。

say.text: 确认数据库连接用的是 PostgreSQL 而不是 SQLite。
say.note: Claude 会检查连接字符串和配置文件。

say.text: 帮我找一下有没有定义了但从未调用的函数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically verify that infrastructure code is actually wired into the system and actively used before you mark it as complete, preventing dead code or unconnected components.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are about to mark infrastructure as complete after development.

say_en.text: Check if the Task tool I just wrote is actually being called.
say_en.note: Claude will trace the execution path and verify invocation.

say_en.text: Confirm the database connection uses PostgreSQL instead of SQLite.
say_en.note: Claude will check connection strings and config files.

say_en.text: Find functions that are defined but never called.
say_en.note: Claude will search for dead code.
